antonio williams.note: 73.2% route rate, 8 targets, 25.7% targets-per-route with McLaurin out; negated 80-yd TD hid a breakout. McLaurin out at least 1 more game; genuine next-man-up.

austin ekeler.note: 16 snaps / 5 touches in debut with Rachaad White sidelined; White expected back. Committee backfield on a mid offense -- no path to standalone value.

brenton strange.note: 88.9% route participation, 36.4% target share, 8 targets/95 yds as Lawrence's No. 1 read vs CIN. Week 5 vs PHI (solid vs TEs) tempers the ceiling, but the role is real.

brian robinson jr..note: 3 TDs Monday night; averaging ~12 touches/game and Falcons are the league's most run-heavy team. Bijan's handcuff first, bye-week flex second.

c.j. stroud.note: Bye-week filler vs Titans; fine floor with Nico Collins healthy (9.0 YPA together) but no ceiling play.

cade otton.note: Quiet but startable TE depth in a decent TB passing game while Mayfield is out.

cyrus allen.note: Camp-hype rookie who may inherit real routes with Tyquan Thornton out 12-16 weeks (surgery) and Rashee Rice still out. Not startable yet -- pure ceiling stash on the league's best offense.

dameon pierce.note: Most likely PHI practice-squad call-up if Barkley sits; fits the early-down side of a Shipley split. Only worth the bid if Barkley is ruled out.

darius cooper.note: 2 TDs on only 3 targets with DeVonta Smith (hamstring) out -- TD-chasing, not role-chasing. Fool's-gold profile until he draws real targets two weeks straight.

deshaun watson.note: Cleveland is a garbage offense -- excluded regardless of QB13 PPG. Hard pass.

dohnte meyers.note: 90.1% routes, 9 targets, 7/82 with Chase (concussion) and Higgins (adductor) out -- but one-week rental at best since Chase is back after the Week 6 bye. Bid like a rental, not a breakout.

emanuel wilson.note: Consensus #1 add: 21 carries/81 yds + 3 rec/39 yds, 100% of RB red-zone work, 46.2% route participation as Seattle's lead back with Charbonnet (PUP) and Price (IR) out. Mixon reportedly failed his physical, so the window is multi-week.

isaac teslaa.note: 4-95 on 8 targets only because Detroit trailed all night and Goff threw 52 times; fourth in the target pecking order. Schedule/game-script mirage.

isaiah williams.note: 2-73-1 highlighted by a 58-yard garbage-time TD; drops to WR3 when Adonai Mitchell (finger) returns in a weak passing attack. Trap.

jacoby brissett.note: Home vs DET (54.5-point total) in the week's best QB streaming matchup; Lions have allowed the most points over expected to QBs.

jalon daniels.note: Dual-threat debut (55 rush yds, most among QBs Week 4) with Mayfield out 6-8 weeks (thumb). Elite matchup vs DAL, but the passing is raw -- stash, don't spend.

jaylen wright.note: Took a backseat to Ollie Gordon in Miami's backfield; Miami is a garbage offense. Excluded.

joe mixon.note: Seattle workout did not lead to a signing -- reports say he failed the physical at 30 with a year off. Red flag; do not chase.

kaelon black.note: Role shrinking with CMC back to bell-cow usage (8 snaps, 13 yds Week 4). One of the best pure handcuffs in fantasy, zero standalone value.

kaleb johnson.note: Fumbled near the goal line and the average was inflated by one long run; Lloyd is still ahead. Stash the talent, not the role.

keaton mitchell.note: Led the Chargers backfield in snaps, touches, and carries Week 4, taking work from Omarion Hampton. Explosive enough to start in a timeshare, but the 0-4 Chargers offense and banged-up line cap the ceiling.

keon coleman.note: Career game (6/116/TD) with DJ Moore re-aggravating his shoulder; 77.8% route rate, 7 targets, 13.6 yds/target and 2.41 yds/route. Allen's trust is growing independent of Moore's injury -- genuine breakout trend on an elite offense.

khalil shakir.note: Led BUF in receptions/targets (7/8 for 82) with Moore out half the game, but was under 50 yards in all three prior weeks with a sub-4-yard aDOT. Rental tied to Moore's shoulder -- buy the two-week window, not the season.

kimani vidal.note: Also eating into Hampton's workload alongside Mitchell; deep-league watchlist in a bad offense.

kirk cousins.note: QB4 in passing fantasy points per game with the 3-1 Raiders, but Week 5 matchup vs NE is not ideal. Fine streamer, no ceiling.

malik washington.note: Miami is a garbage offense. Excluded regardless of box score.

michael mayer.note: 8-82 on 10 targets was the career game, but he drew only 3 targets the week before with Bowers back and Bowers remains the alpha. Low-floor TE2 -- do not chase Week 4.

mike gesicki.note: CIN's pass-catching TE with Chase/Higgins out; strong Week 5 spot vs MIA soft defense. One-week streamer window before the Week 6 bye.

oronde gadsden.note: Clear-cut short-term starter with Kolar/Njoku on IR, but flopped in Week 3 and has flopped before -- pure boom-bust TE2.

roman wilson.note: TDs in back-to-back weeks hide a 16% target share and the fourth-fewest routes among PIT WRs (22 of 71 snaps). Low floor, TD-or-bust profile.

t.j. hockenson.note: 13-of-13 for 119 yards on 83% snaps as Murray's lead receiver with Justin Jefferson (ankle) out; MIN may hold Jefferson through the Week 6 bye. The offense is ugly, but 13 targets is elite TE usage.

tank dell.note: Practice window open, return date unknown; speculative stash on a good offense only.

tre harris.note: Led LAC in routes Week 4 (5 targets vs Johnston's 2) and has beaten Johnston in every efficiency metric; McConkey day-to-day. Short-term WR1 juice, but the 0-4 Chargers offense limits the runway -- already rostered by Kenny, hold.

tyler allgeier.note: Out-snapped Love 36-30 (27 of 41 pass plays) with Love's ankle being managed; if Love sits vs DET, Allgeier is an immediate flex. Committee ceiling with a healthy Love -- rental, not a season-changer.

tyler higbee.note: Rams TE room is banged up and Higbee could see a bigger workload; quiet floor play.

tyreek hill.note: Free agent after leaving Miami; Chiefs reportedly reached out with Thornton out for the season and Rice still out. Elite ceiling if he lands with Mahomes, zero value until he signs -- bench hold only.

tyson bagent.note: Starting again for Chicago with Mayfield out 6-8 weeks; fine in superflex/2QB, stash elsewhere.

will shipley.note: Only healthy back on PHI's active roster with Barkley week-to-week and Bigsby on IR -- but Sharp's warning stands: career passing-down profile (71.4% of snaps on passing plays), poor JAX run matchup, and Dameon Pierce could be promoted to take early-down work. One-week rental, bid like one.

picks.name: Emanuel Wilson
picks.why: Consensus No. 1 add. Seattle's lead back with Charbonnet (PUP) and Price (IR) out: 21 carries/81 yds + 3 rec/39 yds in Week 4, 100% of RB red-zone work, 46.2% route participation. Mixon reportedly failed his physical, so the multi-week window holds.

picks.name: T.J. Hockenson
picks.why: 13-of-13 targets for 119 yards on 83% of snaps as Kyler Murray's lead receiver with Justin Jefferson (ankle) out; Vikings may hold Jefferson through the Week 6 bye. 13 targets is elite TE usage in a shallow position.

picks.name: Keon Coleman
picks.why: Career game (6/116/TD) after DJ Moore re-aggravated his shoulder; 77.8% route rate, 7 targets, 13.6 yds/target, 2.41 yds/route. Allen's trust is growing independent of the injury -- genuine third-year breakout on an elite offense.

picks.name: Antonio Williams
picks.why: 73.2% route rate and 8 targets with McLaurin sidelined; an 80-yard TD was negated by holding (would have been 20+ PPR). 25.7% targets-per-route ranks 21st among WRs -- real next-man-up usage, not box-score luck.

picks.name: Khalil Shakir
picks.why: Led Buffalo in receptions and targets (7/8 for 82) with Moore out half the game. Caution: under 50 yards in all three prior weeks with a sub-4-yard aDOT -- buy the 1-2 week Moore window, not a season breakout.

picks.name: Tyler Allgeier
picks.why: Out-snapped Jeremiyah Love 36-30 in Week 4 (27 of 41 pass plays) with Love's ankle being managed. If Love sits vs DET, Allgeier is an immediate flex with goal-line juice.

picks.name: Will Shipley
picks.why: Only healthy back on Philadelphia's active roster with Barkley week-to-week (hamstring) and Bigsby on IR. Caution: career passing-down profile, elite JAX run defense, and Dameon Pierce could be promoted for early-down work -- price as a one-week rental.

picks.name: Keaton Mitchell
picks.why: Led the Chargers backfield in snaps, touches, and carries in Week 4, taking work from rookie Omarion Hampton. Explosive enough to start in a timeshare; discount for the 0-4 offense and banged-up line.

picks.name: Tre Harris
picks.why: Led the Chargers in routes in Week 4 (5 targets vs Johnston's 2) and has beaten Quentin Johnston in every efficiency metric this year. McConkey is day-to-day; short-term WR1 juice with Denver down both starting corners.

picks.name: Dohnte Meyers
picks.why: 90.1% route rate, 9 targets, 7/82 with Chase (concussion) and Higgins (adductor) out -- but one-week rental at best since Chase returns after the Week 6 bye. Kenny's rule: backup-WR talent question means 5% max.
